description: Searches text or a regular expression across project files and returns file paths with line numbers. What the engine steps over is not searched: directories spelled with a dot, node_modules, and any directory holding a .gdignore. A vendored engine or an export directory is therefore absent from the results rather than matching the code you are looking for in a copy nobody runs.

fileTypes.description: Extensions to search, such as ["gd", "tscn"]. Default: every text file.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory, the one holding project.godot.

query.description: The text or pattern to find.

regex.description: Read the query as a regular expression. Default false.

name: project_search
